locator.text: Equation (A.42), p. 139, in the proof of Proposition A.7

evidence: paper: \left|\partial_\eta^m \Delta \int_0^\infty (H - H_{\mathrm{pow}})\, dX\right| \le C_m e_K X_K^{1/2} \int_1^\infty x^{-A-1/2}\, dx \le C_{m,h}\, e_K X_K^{1/2}.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same inequality after routine rewritings, checked term by term. H_pow does not depend on the heat edit, so Δ∫(H - H_pow) dX = Δ∫ H dX = ∫ √(2X)(E - E_cl) dX, which is literally HeatTailEdit.angularDebt (HeatedOutgoing.renormalized_decomposition exhibits the same cancellation for the compensated profile); the Lean's physicalAngular is √2 times etaDebt with q = 1/2, and the explicit Real.sqrt 2 accounts for the √(2X) weight. Lower limit 0 versus K agrees because change vanishes below the switch radius. The K-power matches: K^{1/2} = Real.sqrt K is the paper's X_K^{1/2}, and tailSize d false = e_K (not squared, matching square = false) is the paper's e_K. The paper's ∫_1^∞ x^{-A-1/2} dx = 1/(A - 1/2) = 1/h is exactly nuConstant's denominator -tailDecay d false - 1/2 = A - 1/2, so the paper's second step with constant C_{m,h} depending on h as well as m corresponds to the h-dependence of etaConstant through d.h. Differentiation is in η on Icc (-1) 1 in both.
